From the perspective of a strict OOP learner at that time, JS has countless cons to me. And thats where TypeScript come in and solve it for me. It does not like 100% fixing everything, but some major problem is solve, and I love the way Microsoft really listen to the developer to improve and enhance it. At least until now I'm still TypeScript-ing everyday
